name: Fire Hydrant
summary: A quadruped hip abduction that trains the outer glutes and hip stability.
setup: Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your back flat and abs braced.
execution: Lift one knee out to the side, keeping it bent at 90 degrees.
Raise it to about hip height without rotating the torso.
Pause and squeeze the outer hip.
mistakes: Torso tilting or shifting: brace the abs and reduce the height.
Rocking the pelvis: lift only as high as the hips stay level.
Collapsing into the shoulders: press the floor away.
